title: Finite-field pro-étale ordinary direct-image finiteness
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, $k$ a field of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and $A$ a finite field of characteristic $\ell$. Let $f:T\to V$ be a finite-type $k$-morphism between finite-type $k$-schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use ordinary uncompleted derived categories of module sheaves over the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ on small pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $\mathcal B_A(T)$ for the complexes whose cohomology vanishes outside a finite interval and is constructible [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]: there is a finite constructible locally closed stratification on which each cohomology sheaf is pro-étale locally constant with finite-dimensional $A$-module values. Then the ordinary total right derived functor $Rf_*$ [def-sfb-right-derived-functor] of the module direct image $f_*$ [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image], computed by applying $f_*$ to a K-injective resolution, satisfies $Rf_*\mathcal B_A(T)\subseteq\mathcal B_A(V)$. No finiteness, perfection or separable closedness of $k$ is assumed.

proof.text: The source T is locally Noetherian by finite type over Spec k. A locally Noetherian scheme is quasi-separated; hence f is quasi-separated by qcqs morphism permanence. Quasi-compactness of f is already a hypothesis. This supplies precisely the hypotheses of direct-image comparison without separatedness.

Use the proved exact constant-scalar restriction equivalence proEtaleModuleRestriction with lifted coefficients ULift A. Its homology comparison preserves vanishing and its constructibility equivalence identifies the global finite-stratification predicates. Apply the already proved general fixedDerivedOrigin helper in ProEtaleConstructibleOrigin to descend the resulting bounded fixed-module complex to a bounded constructible etale complex J. The helper works for every finite commutative coefficient ring; no finite-field datum, adic coefficient presentation, or affine-local stratification is used.

The positive characteristic p of the field k is prime. If ell vanished in k, p would divide the prime ell, so p=1 or p=ell, both impossible. Therefore ell is a unit in k; it annihilates A and ULift A. Transport the unit to global sections of Spec k and apply the existing arbitrary-field finite-type etale finiteness theorem to J. It gives an output interval [aO,bO] and constructible etale cohomology.

Regard J as bounded below using its given lower cohomological bound. Apply the canonical qcqs direct-image comparison on D-plus. Compose its isomorphism with the full/plus compatibility isomorphisms, the antecedent isomorphism, and the already proved restrictionDerivedDirectImageIso helper of ProEtaleClassicalDirectImagePreservation. This identifies comparison pullback of the ordinary etale direct image with scalar restriction of the ordinary intrinsic pro-etale direct image of K. The helper is the exact equivalence compatibility of direct images, and does not invoke a constructible finiteness assertion.

The module categories have the recorded K-injective resolutions. Choose a K-injective representative I of K using exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isKInjective. The standard derived direct image at Q I is Q(f_* I) by rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso. The arbitrary-resolution derived functor in the assertion has the same value by rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutionsObjIso applied to the identity resolution of I. Compose these isomorphisms and the images of K isomorphic to Q I. Thus the two full-category functors agree on this input without choosing any new functor or coefficient object.

Exact etale-to-pro-etale comparison commutes with homology and sends zero objects to zero objects. Apply homology to the isomorphisms of the preceding two steps, then reflect zero objects through scalar restriction. This gives vanishing outside [aO,bO]. Comparison carries each constructible etale homology sheaf to a constructible fixed-module sheaf; transport it through the same homology isomorphisms and use proEtaleModuleRestriction_constructible_iff to recover intrinsic global constructibility. Pair the interval certificate with the degreewise constructibility certificates.
